Good length from Blades, outside off stump. De Kock gets on the back foot and slices a square cut for one run.
FOUR MORE! Length ball, pitching outside off stump. De Kock moves onto the back foot and pulls for four runs.
On a good line and length from Blades. De Kock gets on the back foot and defends

commentary.label: W
commentary.commentary: OUT! Blades gets the wicket! Back of a length from Blades, outside off stump. Carter rocks back and skies a pull, but is caught by Hendricks
On a good length, pitching outside off. Carter rocks back and drives shakily through the off side.
Good line and length from Blades. Carter gets on the front foot, and is hit on the pads while trying a flick

commentary.label: 2w
commentary.commentary: Wide. Pitching well down the leg side. Carter goes back but makes no contact while trying a pull
Full ball, outside off. King moves onto the front foot and punches a drive down the ground.
Good line and length. Carter gets on the front foot and drives for one run on the leg side.
FOUR! Good length from Paul, pitching outside off. Carter moves onto the back foot and slices a cut for four runs.
On a good length, outside off stump. Carter moves onto the front foot but makes no contact while attempting to play a drive
On a good line and length once more. King moves onto the back foot and slices a square cut for a run.
Good line and length. King pushes forward and glances
On a good line and length from Russell. Carter gets on the front foot and drives shakily
FOUR! Russell drops one in short, pitching on a good line. Carter moves onto the back foot and edges back behind point for 4 runs.
Back of a length, outside off. King rocks back and slices a square cut through point for a single run.
Good length from Russell, pitching outside off stump. Carter gets on the back foot and plays a cut for one run behind point.
And again! Back of a length from Russell, pitching near leg stump and angling across Carter. He moves onto the back foot and pulls back behind square for 6 runs.
And again! Full, on a good line. Carter moves onto the front foot and eases a drive for four runs.
Length ball, outside off stump. Carter gets on the front foot and drives averagely for a run through the off side.
And again! Full ball, pitching on leg and angling across Carter. He pushes forward and plays a flick for 4 runs.
On a good line and length from Blades again. Carter moves onto the front foot and punches a drive down the ground.
Good line and length from Blades. Carter pushes forward and punches a drive for a couple of runs on the leg side.

commentary.label: 10w
commentary.commentary: Wide. Pitching far outside leg.
On a good line and length. King gets on the front foot and flicks a glance for a run behind square on the leg side.
Back-to-back boundaries! Full toss, outside off once more. King pushes forward and drives for 4 runs.
